headword: {傍若無人|ぼうじゃくぶじん}
gloss: arrogant, behaving as if no one else exists

definitions.gloss: arrogant, behaving as if no one else exists
definitions.explanation: A four-character idiom describing someone who acts selfishly and inconsiderately, as if they were completely alone and others don't matter.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{傍若無人|ぼうじゃくぶじん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{振|ふ}る{舞|ま}った→振る舞う：04233_furumau⟧。
examples.english: He behaved arrogantly, as if no one else mattered.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{傍若無人|ぼうじゃくぶじん}な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: There are people who behave inconsiderately on trains.

examples.japanese: {傍若無人|ぼうじゃくぶじん}な⟦{運転|うんてん}→運転：01335_unten⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こした→起こす：01234_okosu⟧。
examples.english: The reckless driving caused an accident.

notes:
FOUR-CHARACTER IDIOM (⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧)

LITERAL MEANING: ⟦{傍|かたわ}ら→傍ら：11525_katawara⟧ (beside) + ⟦{若|ごと}し→若し：noentry⟧ (as if) + ⟦{無人|むじん}→無人：13388_mujin⟧ (no people) = Acting as if there were no one beside you.

ORIGIN: From the Chinese historical text 《⟦{史記|しき}→史記：29596_shiki⟧》 (Records of the Grand Historian), describing the behavior of the assassin ⟦{荊軻|けいか}→荊軻：noentry⟧ (Jing Ke).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {傍若無人|ぼうじゃくぶじん}な＋noun (arrogant ~)
- {傍若無人|ぼうじゃくぶじん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧＋verb (arrogantly)
- {傍若無人|ぼうじゃくぶじん}な⟦{振|ふ}る{舞|ま}い→振る舞い：10520_furumai⟧ (arrogant behavior)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {傍若無人|ぼうじゃくぶじん}な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧ (arrogant attitude)
- {傍若無人|ぼうじゃくぶじん}な⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧ (inconsiderate behavior)
- {傍若無人|ぼうじゃくぶじん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{振|ふ}る{舞|ま}う→振る舞う：04233_furumau⟧ (to behave arrogantly)

NUANCE: Strongly negative, implying selfishness and complete disregard for others.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{横柄|おうへい}→横柄：07317_ouhei⟧ - arrogant, haughty
- ⟦{尊大|そんだい}→尊大：22538_sondai⟧ - arrogant, self-important
- ⟦{厚顔無恥|こうがんむち}→厚顔無恥：06393_kouganmuchi⟧ - shameless, brazen
